scope: Shaped crafting recipes whose product and ingredients all exist in port/item-catalog.json. Not an item engine and not a crafting UI.

contract.cells: row-major width*height list; null means the slot must be empty
contract.cellAux: -1 means ANY_AUX_VALUE: the ingredient matches any aux value
contract.matching: 3x3 grid with x/y offset scanning and horizontal mirroring, mirroring ShapedRecipy::matches exactly
contract.grid: caller supplies nine item keys row-major; empty string is an empty slot
contract.ordering: recipes are sorted by product id/aux/size/origin, not by upstream insertion order

horizontalMirror.anchor: if (xFlip) expected = recipeItems[(width - xs - 1) + ys * width];

implemented: Shaped recipe data extraction from the pinned tabular sub-registries and the literal inline call sites.
Shape matching with x/y offsets and horizontal mirroring, matching ShapedRecipy::matches.
ANY_AUX_VALUE ingredients: an Item*/Tile* ingredient matches any aux value.
Product identity as an item-catalog key plus the upstream output count.
Reverse lookup: list every recipe producing a given product key.
Rejection of surplus ingredients and of the empty grid.
notImplemented: SMELTING IS NOT IMPLEMENTED THIS ROUND. FurnaceRecipes.cpp is a separate singleton and was skipped.
Shapeless recipes (Recipes.cpp addShapelessRecipy, FoodRecipies, ClothDyeRecipes) are not extracted.
Tool/weapon repair by combining two damaged copies (Recipes.cpp getItemFor) needs a damage field.
Durability consumption, mining speed, harvest-level gating and enchanting.
Armor damage reduction, armor equipping and sword combat bonuses.
Hoe tilling and shears shearing; both need useOn, which does not exist here.
Ingredient consumption and inventory mutation; Crafting.hpp is pure and never touches Inventory.
Recipe group ordering/paging of the original crafting menu.
survivalReachability: Iron and gold ingots come ONLY from smelting (FurnaceRecipes.cpp:20-21) and smelting is not implemented this round, so every iron/gold recipe here - including iron and gold tools, armor, shears and the iron door - is UNREACHABLE in survival play and can only be reached by creative give. Wood and stone recipes are fully reachable; diamond gear is reachable because diamonds drop directly from ore.
uiStatus: There is no crafting-table GUI yet. Recipe matching is a usable backend capability (grid in, product out), but a player cannot craft from the interface until a crafting screen is built.
chainArmor: Chain armor has NO recipe by design: the ArmorRecipes.cpp chain table rows are commented out upstream. The four chain items still exist in the item catalog.
